name: Kit
description: Kit is a persistent memory substrate for AI agents: local, sovereign, MCP-native. This record points at the live public demo (Lady Whiskerdown, a fictional world, so correct recall is provable rather than plausible). The demo's own llms.txt prints a shared read-only bearer key for the MCP endpoint.
access: demo reads are keyless over HTTP; the MCP endpoint takes the shared read-only bearer key published in https://demo.kit-project.com/llms.txt; write access is requested via POST https://demo.kit-project.com/demo/request-access and approved by a human
